target_text: // Query 0 is hardware-visible only. So the software call scores no token.
body:
**[comments] Rule 4, comment lines that map to no code line: shorten**

Three lines above six. 'hardware-visible and not software-required for every token of the page' restates the arguments of add_range (hw_visible with bit 0, an empty sw_required mask, the range 0..page_size). 'in both K layouts' maps to no code line. The one fact the code does not carry is the intent: the mask makes the call score nothing, which is what REQUIRE(relevant_k_tokens == 0) at 3772 checks.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // Query 0 is hardware-visible only. So the software call scores no token.
```
